meta.title: Dunsmuir Visionary Village
meta.subtitle: A Village Begging To Be Born
meta.description: Five historic buildings in Dunsmuir, California — each one a chapter in the same story.

buildings.name: Hotel California Dunsmuir
buildings.description: Built in 1891 at the height of the railroad era. The anchor of downtown Dunsmuir. Structurally sound, architecturally extraordinary, currently vacant and at risk.
buildings.investorNotes: Anchor property. Approximately 8,000 sq ft across three floors. Ground floor commercial potential — restaurant, bar, retail. Upper floors ideal for boutique hotel rooms or residential lofts. Railroad-era brick construction intact. Most significant single asset in the portfolio.

current.label: Present
current.description: The hotel as it stands today. Vacant, weathered, waiting. The bones are extraordinary.

historical.label: Past
historical.description: At its peak, this hotel was the social center of Dunsmuir. Railroad workers, travelers, and the whole commerce of a mountain town passed through these doors.

vision.label: Vision
vision.description: Not a restoration. A transformation. A boutique hotel and gathering space at the center of a village for visionaries.

clue.hint: Listen carefully at the front desk. A name is spoken.
clue.unlocksMessage: The California Theatre — across the street, holding a different kind of memory.

buildings.name: Historic California Theatre
buildings.tagline: Where the community gathered to dream
buildings.description: A 1926 performing arts theatre across the street from the hotel. Culture, performance, and community memory embedded in every wall.
buildings.investorNotes: Performing arts venue with original stage infrastructure. Significant cultural asset for the community. Activation potential as event space, cinema, live performance. Connected to the Annex for expanded programming.

current.label: Present
current.description: The theatre stands silent. The stage waits.

historical.label: Past
historical.description: Performances, gatherings, the social fabric of a mountain town woven through decades of shared experience.

vision.label: Vision
vision.description: A living cultural anchor for the village. Performances, screenings, gatherings for the community of visionaries.

clue.hint: Find the poster on the back wall. What year does it show?
clue.unlocksMessage: The Annex — adjacent, connected, its own story.

buildings.name: Theatre Annex Building
buildings.description: Adjacent to the theatre. A building with its own identity — commercial, civic, layered with a different kind of history.
buildings.investorNotes: Commercial building adjacent to theatre. Natural programming extension — rehearsal space, gallery, studio, workshop. Creates a connected cultural campus with the Theatre.

current.label: Present
current.description: A narrow building pressed up against the theatre. Quiet now, but the walls remember.

historical.label: Past
historical.description: For decades the Annex served as an extension of the theatre's life — storage, rehearsal, overflow. It had its own pulse.

vision.label: Vision
vision.description: Gallery space, studios, workshops — the creative engine adjacent to the cultural stage.

clue.hint: Look for the mark on the threshold. Something was measured here.
clue.unlocksMessage: Castle Rock Inn — down the block, a different kind of gathering place.

buildings.name: Castle Rock Inn
buildings.tagline: Where travelers stayed and stories were traded
buildings.description: Further down Cedar Street. A different scale, a different character. The Inn held a more intimate kind of history.
buildings.investorNotes: Smaller scale property on Cedar. Boutique inn or residential conversion. Anchors the western end of the portfolio corridor. Creates bookend with Hotel California.

current.label: Present
current.description: Quieter than the hotel, smaller in scale — but the bones are honest. Cedar Street keeps its secrets.

historical.label: Past
historical.description: Travelers who couldn't get a room at the hotel ended up here. Different stories. Same mountain.

vision.label: Vision
vision.description: A boutique inn reimagined — intimate, warm, the western anchor of the village corridor.

clue.hint: Someone mentions where they came from. Follow that road.
clue.unlocksMessage: The Energy Station — at the edge of town, where the journey begins and ends.

buildings.name: Dunsmuir Energy Station
buildings.description: At the edge of the portfolio. A gas station, a threshold, the point of arrival and departure. In the village vision it becomes something entirely new.
buildings.investorNotes: Corner property at the edge of downtown. High visibility. Unique adaptive reuse potential — energy hub, EV charging, community gateway. Conceptually the entrance to the village.

current.label: Present
current.description: A corner property at the edge of downtown. Faded signage, cracked concrete — but the location is everything.

historical.label: Past
historical.description: In its heyday the station was the first point of contact for anyone arriving in Dunsmuir. It marked the threshold.

vision.label: Vision
vision.description: The gateway to the village. Where the journey ends and the new story begins.

clue.hint: You have found all five. The village is revealed.
clue.unlocksMessage: You have walked through every building. You have heard every story. Now you know what this place is asking to become.
